table.name: car_makers
table.purpose: Lookup table of automobile manufacturers (brands), each with its home country. One row per car maker (22 makers).

Country.name: country_id
Country.description: Foreign key to countries.CountryId; the maker's home country (e.g. 2=germany, 4=japan, 7=uk).

FullName.name: full_name
FullName.description: Full official name of the car maker (e.g. 'American Motor Company', 'Daimler Benz', 'General Motors').

Id.name: maker_id
Id.description: Primary key; unique maker identifier, referenced by model_list.Maker.

Maker.name: maker_name
Maker.description: Short/lowercase brand name of the maker (e.g. 'gm', 'bmw', 'volkswagen'); matches model_list.Model one-to-one.

table.name: car_names
table.purpose: Names of individual car models (make + model name) with the maker/brand; one row per named car (406 rows, matching cars_data one-to-one).

Make.name: make_name
Make.description: Full car name, brand plus model (e.g. 'amc matador', 'chevrolet nova', 'audi 4000').

MakeId.name: car_id
MakeId.description: Primary key; unique car identifier, matches cars_data.Id/Horsepower values 1-406 (same car listing).

table.name: cars_data
table.purpose: Technical specifications of cars (classic 1970-1982 auto-mpg dataset): one row per car with MPG, cylinders, displacement, horsepower, weight, acceleration and model year.

Accelerate.name: acceleration
Accelerate.description: Acceleration, most likely 0-60 mph time in seconds (range 8.0-24.8, mean ~15.5).

Edispl.name: engine_displacement
Edispl.description: Engine displacement in cubic inches (range 68-455, typical US cu in values like 350, 318, 400).

Horsepower.name: horsepower
Horsepower.description: Engine horsepower (46-230 hp). The detected join to car_names.MakeId is spurious: values coincide numerically because both run 1-406-ish; it is really a spec attribute, with Id being the link to car_names.

Id.name: car_id
Id.description: Primary key; unique car identifier 1-406, corresponds to car_names.MakeId.

MPG.name: mpg
MPG.description: Fuel economy in miles per gallon (9.0-46.6).

ContId.name: continent_id
ContId.description: Primary key; continent identifier, referenced by countries.Continent.

Continent.name: continent_name
Continent.description: Continent name: america, europe, asia, africa, australia.

table.name: countries
table.purpose: Lookup table of countries (15 rows), each assigned to a continent; referenced by car_makers for maker home country.

CountryId.name: country_id
CountryId.description: Primary key; country identifier, referenced by car_makers.Country.

table.name: model_list
table.purpose: List of car models/brands (36 rows) mapping each model name to its maker (car_makers).

Maker.name: maker_id
Maker.description: Foreign key to car_makers.Id; the maker producing this model (e.g. 4=General Motors, 13=Daimler Benz).
